summary_1line: Mortally wounded, Bali reconciles with Sugriva, entrusts Angada to him, advises loyalty to Rama, and dies after giving away his royal golden chain.

image_candidates.scene_text: The dying Bali lies pierced by Rama’s arrow while handing his radiant golden chain to the sorrowful Sugriva.
Angada stands weeping beside his fallen father Bali as the monkey chiefs gather in grief around the battlefield.
With fading breath, Bali gazes tenderly at Angada and instructs him to serve Sugriva before his life finally departs.
